svg.title: SkillSync: Skill swap, not skill shop.
svg.text: Learn something new, teach something you know
SkillSync connects people who want to learn with people who
already know how. No fees for learning something new —
just trade a skill you have for one you want.
free forever · no credit card · browse before you sign up
